test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Identify the name of the fellowship that is launched by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, to recognise, encourage and support translational research by Indian nationals.

options.text: Dr. Homi Jahangir Bhabha Technology Innovation National Fellowship
CV Raman Technology Innovation National Fellowship
Vikram Sarabhai Technology Innovation National Fellowship
Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship

solution:
The correct answer is __**Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Abdul Kalam Technology Innovation National Fellowship** is an initiative by the **Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India**.
 
• It is designed to **recognize and support Indian nationals **engaged in high-impact, translational research that has the potential to solve societal problems.
 
• The fellowship particularly **encourages researchers** who are working towards innovation and technological solutions,
 
• It bridges the **gap between laboratory research and real-world application.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The key objectives of the fellowship are to:

 
• **Encourage innovation**: The fellowship promotes original research and innovation that can lead to new technologies, products, or processes.
 
• **Support translation**: It focuses on helping researchers bring their ideas and inventions to practical use, especially in sectors such as healthcare, agriculture, energy, and manufacturing.
 
• **Provide financial and institutional support**: Fellows receive financial assistance and are often given access to necessary infrastructure to carry out their work.
